ref: IMG_4440 contact-sheet f007 (only view: oblique from below, 'Foot Lock' in frame, the 'er' cut off), f006
notes: Seen only in the contact-sheet tile IMG_4440 f007 (the signs/ full-res file named f007 shows the corridor, not the sign), oblique from below with 'Foot Lock' in frame. Red-face lit channel letters, light grey/silver returns about 12 cm deep, on a brushed stainless/grey metal fascia band over a full-glass front. Mixed case, very heavy, slightly italic, large x-height: set in Inter Black sheared 0.12. The view is foreshortened ~2x horizontally, so the letters' true width can't be read off the frame: the width is the font's natural width, and the check box is stretched to the partial view (letter shapes and weights compare, not the overall width). No stripe/referee logo seen (it may be off frame to the right). Cap height 0.55 m is a guess from the fascia band.
